items.stem: Choose the correct past form: "Hier, je ___ au cinema." (completed single past action)

options.rationale: Correct: a completed single past action uses the passe compose, "je suis alle".
The imparfait "allais" describes a habitual or ongoing past, not a single completed action.

items.stem: Which TWO sentences use the correct article or preposition?

options.rationale: Correct: "venir de" with a feminine country uses "de la", giving "de la France".
Correct: "aller a" with "ecole" (vowel start) gives "a l'ecole".
"Pomme" is feminine, so it needs "la pomme", not "le pomme".

options.text: Nous allons a Paris en voiture rouge.
options.rationale: It needs "en voiture rouge" with an article: "dans une voiture rouge" or "en voiture"; "voiture rouge" lacks the article.
One says "habite a Lyon", not "dans Lyon".

items.explanation: Correct: "venir de" with a feminine country uses "de la", giving "de la France".
